proc certVerifyContent(forServer: bool; transcriptHash: openArray[byte]): seq[
    byte] {....raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
64 spaces + context string + 0x00 + transcript hash (RFC 8446 S4.4.3). forServer selects the "server CertificateVerify" context (server sending CV, or anyone verifying one); false selects the client one.
